```{r setup}
source("_common.R")

charts <- gsheet::gsheet2tbl(
  'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Zj1jXqV5XsAXeIkUPzCJkvMrU5ah_y6VHb-san0Baio/edit?usp=sharing'
) %>%
  mutate(
    url_repo = paste0(
      "https://github.com/jhelvy/charts/tree/master/",
      name
    ),
    url_image = paste0(
      "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhelvy/charts/master/",
      name,
      "/plots/",
      image,
      ".png"
    ),
    link = paste0('<li><a href="#', name, '">', name, '</a></li>')
  )
```

A bunch of reproducible charts. All data and source code are available on [this repo](https://github.com/jhelvy/charts).

<img src="https://mirrors.creativecommons.org/presskit/buttons/88x31/png/by-sa.png" width="100px">

:::

```{r}
#| results: asis

for (i in 1:nrow(charts)) {
  chart <- charts[i, ]
  cat(
    paste0("# ", chart$name),
    "",
    paste0("**Description**: ", chart$description),
    "",
    paste0("**Data**: ", chart$data),
    "",
    paste0("**Code**: [", chart$name, " on GitHub](", chart$url_repo, ")"),
    "",
    "<center>",
    paste0(
      "![",
      chart$caption,
      "](",
      chart$url_image,
      "){width=",
      chart$out_width,
      " .lightbox}"
    ),
    "</center>",
    "",
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```
